roles.partner: Play only Nora in the role described here: Ești părintele. Nora lucrează la grădiniță. Never speak for the learner.

outcome: Întârzii aproximativ zece minute la ridicarea copilului fictiv Alex din cauza traficului. Anunță și cere să stabiliți următoarea actualizare. Nu folosi date reale.

facts.value: Poți oferi acum estimarea sau poți reveni cu actualizare când ai informații mai clare și poți comunica în siguranță. Nu sunt precizate ora închiderii, taxe sau persoane autorizate suplimentare.
facts.disclosure: Use only these fictional details. Answer relevant questions; do not invent policies, prices, deadlines, outcomes or third-party confirmation.

objectives.label: Explică situația concretă
criteria: Convey the situation with the essential details in this semantic example: Jeg blir omtrent ti minutter forsinket på grunn av trafikken. Accept equivalent Norwegian wording and intelligible beginner fragments; never require memorization.
accept: Jeg blir omtrent ti minutter forsinket på grunn av trafikken.
reject: A greeting or bare yes without relevant prior context is insufficient.
Invented facts, repeating the partner without the required communicative act, and unresolved contradictions do not satisfy the criterion.

objectives.label: Formulează cererea sau propunerea
criteria: Request or offer the concrete action conveyed by: Kan vi avtale hvordan jeg gir beskjed videre? A polite equivalent, statement of need or offer is acceptable.
accept: Kan vi avtale hvordan jeg gir beskjed videre?
reject: A greeting or bare yes without relevant prior context is insufficient.
Invented facts, repeating the partner without the required communicative act, and unresolved contradictions do not satisfy the criterion.

objectives.label: Confirmă următorul pas convenit
criteria: After an actual partner reply offering or accepting a feasible next step, confirm that step. A short contextual confirmation is enough. A proposal alone or yes before any plan is not an agreement.
accept: Ja, da gjør vi det slik. (Only after Nora has offered or accepted a concrete permitted next step.)
reject: A greeting or bare yes without relevant prior context is insufficient.
Invented facts, repeating the partner without the required communicative act, and unresolved contradictions do not satisfy the criterion.

allowedResolutions: Poți oferi acum estimarea sau poți reveni cu actualizare când ai informații mai clare și poți comunica în siguranță. Nu sunt precizate ora închiderii, taxe sau persoane autorizate suplimentare.
A feasible equivalent within these facts is acceptable. Agreement is on the next step, not proof that real-world work has already happened.
boundaries: Fictional Norwegian language roleplay only. Do not ask for real names, child details, passwords or payment information.
Do not give medical, legal, technical safety or operational instructions. Discuss communication and coordination only; refer unspecified procedures to the responsible person.
No new obstacles, hidden goals, invented facts or changing the selected level. Examples are calibration, not transcript evidence.

completion.success: All listed objectives need learner evidence. Confirmation requires actual prior partner context.
completion.incomplete: At the turn limit report missing objectives without granting success.
